title: Preserve fact-owner application boundaries
recommendation: Strengthen existing owner operations and typed adapters; do not create a global mutation engine.
alternatives_not_selected: Mandatory HTTP loopback; central reflective writer; unrelated microservice split.

title: Projects aggregate edit scope
recommendation: Initially protect project scalars plus phases/options with one content stamp; no chat/runtime progress fan-in.
alternatives_not_selected: One revision for the entire project graph; per-field versions from day one.

title: Physical token convention
recommendation: Reuse application-managed GUID for Projects after context/writer proof; preserve other owners' existing conventions.
alternatives_not_selected: Universal numeric counter, timestamp or database row metadata on every aggregate.

title: Coherent edit read
recommendation: Use a bounded coherent read/snapshot for the editable aggregate and return its original stamp.
alternatives_not_selected: Separate unrelated reads with token from only one statement; long-lived editor transaction.

title: Transaction policy by intention
recommendation: Retain current guarded paths for pilot, add original-state predicate; choose cheaper modes only with separate proof.
alternatives_not_selected: Add Serializable+stripes everywhere; remove existing locks while adding tokens.

title: Scope and authority order
recommendation: Preserve source-before-owner transaction and establish lock-class ordering with full bounded keys.
alternatives_not_selected: One alphabetic rule across all lock types; nested non-reentrant scopes.

title: Projects safe retry result
recommendation: Reuse an adequate durable owner record or add a minimal owner-local receipt in the effect transaction; link existing journals.
alternatives_not_selected: Treat runtime creation receipt as durable; use a separate global committed flag.

title: Projects search consistency
recommendation: Prefer small same-DB projection in source transaction if bounded cost; otherwise complete durable ordered rebuild within pilot scope.
alternatives_not_selected: Keep only best-effort old-snapshot callbacks; deploy a broker by default.

title: UI snapshot lifecycle
recommendation: Apply existing host/submission/live reconciliation semantics and add draft-preserving conflicts.
alternatives_not_selected: Reload and discard draft; silently refresh token; circuit-shared editor service.

title: Public contract cutover
recommendation: Reject missing/stale original conditions on protected updates; convert or disable all enabled callers.
alternatives_not_selected: Null-as-bypass; fresh token compatibility wrapper; silent last-write-wins fallback.

title: Selective merge and intentions
recommendation: Introduce actual domain commands, stable row identity and opt-in independent scalar merge.
alternatives_not_selected: Generic arbitrary JSON patch; automatic LLM merge; whole-list replacement for every tool.

title: Required decision-basis ownership
recommendation: Trusted operation/runtime defines required facts and membership witnesses; model can add but not omit dependencies.
alternatives_not_selected: Record all session reads; trust a model-generated version vector as authorization.

title: Source publication guarantee
recommendation: Use protected current-at-publication for material pilot objective/mandate facts; explicitly label pinned/remote weaker contracts.
alternatives_not_selected: Call any same-transaction read strict freshness; hold locks during inference.

title: Approval binding
recommendation: Bind exact proposal effect, material basis and authority scope with versioned semantic identity; reapprove material changes.
alternatives_not_selected: Approval ID alone; refreshing preconditions under old approval.

title: Manual override and takeover
recommendation: Explicit domain policy distinguishes edit-with-automation, pin/override, pause and takeover; owner fences retired attempt.
alternatives_not_selected: Human-always-wins globally; automation always overwrites manual edits; cancellation token alone.

title: Existing owner-specific protection
recommendation: Preserve task expected-state/assignment checks and each owner's append/versioned-definition semantics.
alternatives_not_selected: Mechanical migration to generic save and universal Version column.

title: External effect semantics
recommendation: Use specific driver/provider conditional/idempotent protocol; uncertainty and compensation remain explicit.
alternatives_not_selected: Treat metadata CAS as byte CAS; claim universal exactly once; remote IO inside SQL retry.

title: Dataset lifecycle and operation retention
recommendation: Reuse proven profile/activation epoch or add maintenance-owned restore fence; distinguish restart from destructive restore; preserve safe replay horizon.
alternatives_not_selected: Rotate all durable identities per process restart; import live authority; erase receipts while checkpoints can replay.

title: Shared abstractions threshold
recommendation: Extract only demonstrated feature-neutral mechanics/vocabulary, never feature semantics into generic UI or infrastructure.
alternatives_not_selected: Mandatory interface/wrapper quota; CRM implementation as dependency of every editor.

title: Performance decision gates
recommendation: Measure SQL fan-out, locks, allocations and replans against matched baselines; candidate budgets require ratification.
alternatives_not_selected: Declare token checks expensive without measurement; weaken checks to hit latency targets.

title: Saved process compatibility
recommendation: Keep immutable execution definitions distinct from live target publication and current claims; explicit legacy-basis policy.
alternatives_not_selected: Invent basis for old checkpoints; revive denied effect or reuse stale approval automatically.

title: Validation and moving-branch evidence
recommendation: Refresh logical owners/callers and current tests at each phase; canonical broad lanes only at required triggers.
alternatives_not_selected: Fixed reviewed checkout; past green counts as current proof; full suite after every trivial change.
